name: Carli Judice
summary: An American flyweight from Headkicks MMA (7-2, age 27), 4-1 in the UFC with knockouts of Duben (R1), Caliari (R3) and Chaves (R1, August). Maycee Barber withdrew from their UFC 335 fight; her new opponent is not yet named.

how_they_fight.Defense: Never stopped: both losses are split decisions.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Has gone three rounds four times.

news.text: Maycee Barber withdrew from their fight; the UFC is looking for a replacement.

sources.title: UFC 335 down a fight with promotion looking to reschedule Maycee Barber's return according to report
